pkgmetadata.longdescription:
Mocktail is a compatibility runtime that runs the Android Roblox client on Linux: the x86-64 client on amd64 and, from the live ebuild onwards, the arm64-v8a client on arm64. It loads the Android shared objects through a vendored Bionic linker inside an ordinary glibc process, bridging the Bionic ABI, EGL/Vulkan WSI, OpenSL ES audio and the JNI surface the client expects.
The Roblox client APK is neither distributed nor redistributed by this package; Mocktail downloads it from a third-party mirror on first launch.
This packaging is maintained independently of upstream. It is not endorsed by or affiliated with the Mocktail project, the Roblox Corporation, or VinegarHQ, and packaging problems should be reported to the ebuild maintainer rather than upstream.
